summary: kepler stub package pulls install-scripted tarball from off-registry host
details: kepler@2.6.999 is a stub package (trivial index.js, generic 'Generated package' README, inflated 2.6.999 version consistent with dependency-confusion targeting of an internal `kepler` name) whose package.json declares a dependency on `flag-serial-object-syntax` resolved directly to `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/flag-serial-object-syntax`, an off-registry URL not under registry.npmjs.org. The shrinkwrap records `hasInstallScript: true` for that dependency, so `npm install kepler` fetches an arbitrary tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and executes its install lifecycle script on the installer's host. The executed code is controlled by whoever operates artifacts.yosiroute.com, not by npm's registry or a verified publisher, and no integrity check gates the fetch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
